content.text: The text combines several works: a Protestant polemic attacking Catholic persecution, the Inquisition, Jesuits, and convents; a travelogue describing journeys through Cornwall—from the Lizard, Kynance Cove, and Land’s End to Marazion, St. Michael’s Mount, St. Ives, and Tintagel; romantic and tragic poems set in India and Central Asia; a pirate adventure in which Hellena escapes Captain Flint’s cave through a secret passage to an Indian village, while Flint flees into the forest and dies in a ravine; and a geographical survey of Morocco, detailing coastal ports, imperial cities such as Fez, Mequinez, and Marrakesh, and interior settlements.
